_comment: 1.28 Together: co-op Village Projects (src/systems/Coop.ts, server section '1.28 co-op village projects' in supabase/schema.sql). A player hosts one project at a time and their friends (at most 30, from their device) add goods to it. When every need is met, everyone who gave gets the project's decoration and a plaque with all their names; if it runs out of time (`days`) or the host cancels it, everyone gets back exactly what they gave. The server keeps its own copy of `projects` (level and needs) in coop_catalog(): validate-data checks they match. `maxGive` is the most one gift can carry, `givesPerDay` the gifts a player can make in a day. A game_config switch `coop` (true/false) turns it off without a release.

projects.name: The Friendship Footbridge
projects.about: A little wooden bridge with your names carved on the rail. Every farm that helps build it gets one of its own.

projects.name: The Community Garden
projects.about: Raised beds and a bench in the sun, planted together. Every helper gets a garden corner for their farm.

projects.name: Fireworks Night
projects.about: One big night of lanterns and fireworks over the water. Everyone who helps gets a fireworks stand that lights up after dark.
